title: Sweet Words to Keep
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A hand reached out and held a scroll
With writing on it too;
"Eat this," the Lord said, "then go speak
The words I give to you."

[Chorus]
Oh, sweet as honey on my tongue,
The words the Lord gives me;
I'll keep them in my heart all day,
As sweet as sweet can be.

[Verse 2]
He trusted Him and opened wide
And ate the scroll right then;
Surprise! It tasted sweet and good,
He smiled and smiled again.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Why eat a scroll? So every word
Would go inside and stay;
Then he could teach them all by heart
And say them every day.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
When someone reads a verse to you,
His good words go in too;
So ask for one sweet verse today
And keep it all day through.

[Chorus]
mood: Tasting music. A light, lilting waltz in three under the voice, like a child swinging her feet under the kitchen table with something sweet in her mouth. A music box picking out the tune, a glockenspiel glinting on the honey words, soft strings far back. Pleased and unhurried rather than solemn, and each chorus lingers a little longer, the way a good taste stays after the spoon is gone.
